_about: A kit sheet for the formula estimate (math-fallback P2, `app/formula/genshin/sheets.py`). Structure (which number buffs what, for whom, under which condition) is transcribed from Genshin Optimizer's character sheets at `go_commit` (MIT), cited per effect to `pando:`/`wr:` file:lines under the `go` roots, and to gcsim's Go at `gcsim_commit` where gcsim implements the same buff. No number is written here: every value is a reference into the seeded catalogue (a talent row by label, a constellation or passive param_list by index), pinned under `pins` so a re-seed that changes one withholds the effect rather than misreading it.

conditions.label: Seconds the active character has fought in Depth-Clarion Dice (A4)

usual.reason: the middle of its ramp: 1%, then 3.5% more a second up to 50% at 14 s, so a hit lands near 7 s on average
usual.cite: KQM Yelan quick guide, keqingmains.com/q/yelan-quickguide/: 'This increases by a further 3.5% DMG every second. The maximum increase to DMG dealt is 50%.'

usual.reason: the estimate scores one target; more opponents in range raise it, so set it to how many you fight

effects.label: A1 Turn Control: Max HP% by the number of different elements in the party
A4 Adapt With Ease: the active character's DMG Bonus, its starting part
A4 Adapt With Ease: the active character's DMG Bonus per second
C4 Bait-and-Switch: party Max HP% per marked opponent

unmodelled.what: The first moment of Depth-Clarion Dice, before any second (1%)
unmodelled.reason: GO's WR sheet offers a 0-second state at 1%; its pando port, followed here, starts at the first second. At the default (14, 50%) both agree

unmodelled.what: Enter the Plotters: an extra Lingering Lifeline charge
unmodelled.reason: no damage effect: a charge (a row's count is the user's)

unmodelled.what: Taking All Comers: an extra arrow with Exquisite Throw
unmodelled.reason: a damage instance, not a buff: not offered as a target row yet
